post.description:
Forget an identity (API section 8.3): the only operation that removes biometric memory. Its
vectors are erased and its faces stop resolving to anyone; the media stays and so does any
Person it was linked to, with their name. A repeat is harmless.

Forget a person (identity model section 46): run `ForgetIdentity` on each identity of the
Person. The Person, their name and notes stay, without visual support. A repeat is harmless.

delete.description:
Logical recycle (API section 5.5): the Source leaves the library view, its bytes, memory and
history stay. A repeat is harmless. Refused while the Source is being processed.

post.description: Bring a recycled Source back (API section 5.6), where possible. A repeat is harmless.
